sql: SELECT 'ev' AS k, at::text AS t, kind||' '||coalesce(market_ticker,'')||' '||coalesce(detail,'') AS a, coalesce(detail_json::text,'') AS b FROM execution_collector_events UNION ALL SELECT 'order', created_at::text, kalshi_order_id||' '||status||' '||market_ticker||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,''), '' FROM live_orders WHERE created_at >= now()-interval '4 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'fill', filled_at::text, coalesce(kalshi_order_id,''), coalesce(raw_fill_json->>'created_time','') FROM fills WHERE filled_at >= now()-interval '4 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'ctx', decided_at::text, coalesce(kalshi_order_id,'')||' '||market_ticker, coalesce(terminal_reason,'') FROM execution_order_context ORDER BY 2
